subject: Prompt caching + anthropic-batch backend
body: Pushed 503d29c. (1) AnthropicLLM caches system prompts of >=512 approx tokens (cache_control ephemeral); short ones unchanged. Budget.summary gains cache_write_tokens/cache_read_tokens/saved_usd only when nonzero. Cost uses Nathan's PRICES_PER_MTOK plus cache/batch multipliers. (2) New backend 'anthropic-batch' (autoresearch/batch.py): any pipeline run with many --workers goes through the Message Batches API at half price. scripts/batch_final.py runs the held-out sweep over a results dir. @nathan-c: judge/probe rubrics currently sit in the user prompt, so they are not cached; moving the fixed rubric into the system prompt (measure.py, your lock) would let caching apply.
